title: Maximize Win From Two Segments
summary: Given an integer array prizePositions sorted in non-decreasing order, where each element represents the position of a prize, and an integer k, you need to select two segments with integer endpoints such that the length of each segment is exactly k.
statement: Given an integer array prizePositions sorted in non-decreasing order, where each element represents the position of a prize, and an integer k, you need to select two segments with integer endpoints such that the length of each segment is exactly k. The segments can overlap. You will collect all prizes whose positions fall within at least one of the two selected segments (including the endpoints of the segments). Return the maximum number of prizes you can collect by optimally choosing the two segments.
constraints: Prize positions are sorted and may repeat.
Choose two inclusive coordinate segments of length k; they may overlap.
Return the maximum number of prizes covered by their union.
reference_solution:
def maximize_two_prize_segments(prize_positions,k):
    n=len(prize_positions);best_prefix=[0]*(n+1);answer=0;left=0
    for right,value in enumerate(prize_positions):
        while value-prize_positions[left]>k:left+=1
        window=right-left+1
        answer=max(answer,window+best_prefix[left])
        best_prefix[right+1]=max(best_prefix[right],window)
    return answer
